history.text: The auth middleware has grown into one 600-line file. Can you split it up and keep the public behaviour identical?

history.html: I read src/middleware/auth.ts. It mixes token parsing, session lookup and role checks. I propose three modules with the same exported authenticate() entry point.

history.text: Sounds good. Keep the old tests untouched so we can prove nothing changed.

history.html: Done. Created token.ts, session.ts and roles.ts. auth.ts is now 48 lines and only wires them together.
All 118 existing tests pass without edits. Lint is clean and the bundle size is unchanged.

history.html: Searching the repo for imports of middleware/auth.
Found 23 call sites in 9 files.

By export:
• authenticate — 14 calls (routes, ws gateway)
• requireRole — 7 calls (admin routes)
• sessionCache — 2 calls, both inside the middleware itself
So the cache can move without touching any caller: nothing outside middleware/ reads it directly.
